blind.description: A deceased armored adventurer or skeleton slumped in a sitting position on the ground, leaning back against a bulky brown leather backpack. The figure wears an iron helmet over a skeletal face, metallic breastplate armor, and brown boots, draped in a tattered red cloak. In its lap rests a green and bronze round shield and an iron sword resting alongside a small wooden chest or container. Surfaces are solid and textured with painted game-asset details.
blind.from_above: Seen directly from above, the model presents a rounded arrangement showing a large brown segmented pack at the top/rear, a helmeted head in the center framed by a frayed red cape, with boots projecting forward and a round green shield and sword visible in the lap.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (less than half the height of the 5 ft 9 in scale figure) and roughly 2.5 to 3 feet in width and depth.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
